example.a: She <m-yellow>had been</m-yellow> <m-blue>elected</m-blue> before they discussed her tasks.
example.b: Sie war gewählt worden, bevor sie ihre Aufgaben diskutierten.
example.sound: She had been elected before they discussed her tasks.

example.a: <m-yellow>Had</m-yellow> they <m-yellow>been</m-yellow> <m-blue>informed</m-blue> before they travelled to Austria?
example.b: Sind sie informiert worden, bevor sie nach Österreich reisten?
example.sound: Had they been informed before they travelled to Austria?

example.a: I <m-yellow>hadn't been</m-yellow> <m-blue>called</m-blue> when I woke up.
example.b: Ich war nicht angerufen worden, als ich aufwachte.
example.sound: I hadn't been called when I woke up.

atoms.b: The tests ((had_been)) completed before the time was over.

atoms.a: Er war nach seiner Meinung gefragt worden, bevor sie die Gruppenpräsentation änderten.
atoms.b: He ((had_been)) asked his opinion before they changed the group presentation.
